newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecommunications sees Q2 revs up.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecommunications sees Q2 revs up.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc on Wednesday said it had estimated revenues of $279 million for the quarter ended April 30, up from $193 million in the same period a year earlier.
The estimate reflects about $30 million of contributions from companies acquired by ADC since April 30, 1996.

For the six months ended April 30, 1997, estimated revenues of $536 million represent a 51 percent increase over the $356 million generated in the same period the previous year, the company said. The estimated contribution from acquired companies for the six months is $70 million.
The company, which makes telecommunications products, expects to announce its final second-quarter results on May 28.
